d:
The Hawks defeated the Cavaliers, 114-111 tonight in Atlanta. Onyeka Okongwu finished with a team-high 29 points along with 12 rebounds and 4 three pointers for the Hawks, while Nickeil Alexander-Walker tallied 25 points, 4 three pointers and 3 rebounds in the game. James Harden recorded 24 points, 5 rebounds and 4 assists. The Hawks improve their record to 3-3 with the win, while the Cavaliers fall to 3-2 for the season.
